ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Retailer acquisition, Terms discussion and later stages need Expected first order value and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retailer_acquisition", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "Contacted", 2, "Line sheet sent", 3, "Range review", 4, "Terms discussion", 5, "Account setup", 6, "Account opened", 7, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(First_order_expected__c), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Expected first order value and Next step date before moving to Terms discussion.
